title: Daniel Erthal: The Ticking Time Bomb Shaking Up A Fazenda
seoTitle: Daniel Erthal: Ticking Time Bomb in A Fazenda
subtitle: Bed dispute highlighted on Central Splash puts the actor in the spotlight
excerpt: Daniel Erthal's explosive debut on A Fazenda sparks controversy, making the actor a focal point of tension and drawing strong viewer interest.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
In the opening moments of the new season of A Fazenda, Daniel Erthal was at the center of an argument that quickly became a hot topic among viewers. The actor, who had already slept on the couch the previous night, clashed with Stephanie Gomes over bed assignments, boosting his visibility on the show.

What drove the tension on Central Splash

The dispute began when new contestants entered the main house, leading to an impasse over sleeping accommodations. Erthal advocated for rotating the contestants to take turns in one of the beds, while Stephanie Gomes disagreed, sparking an exchange of accusations.

How the press describes Erthal's profile

Commentator Bárbara Saryne labeled the actor a "ticking time bomb" and pointed out that this kind of personality can be a key driver of entertainment and conflict throughout the season. She noted that Erthal's reaction was intense and dialed up well beyond what is expected for the start of a reality show.

Daniel Erthal's reaction during the argument

During the disagreement, Erthal publicly voiced his outrage, claiming he was being treated unfairly in the distribution of sleeping spots. He even declared that he would be the only one left without a bed and singled out his voting target, indicating he already knew who he would vote for.

Impact of his explosive demeanor on the game

According to the commentator's analysis, the presence of a contestant with unpredictable behavior shakes up the game and can influence the alliances and strategies of fellow competitors. Erthal's stance in making himself an immediate target for voting signals that he intends to use the tension to his advantage.

Coverage of the argument

Chico Barney and Bárbara Saryne are following the case in special celebrity and reality show coverage on YouTube and Canal UOL, extending the conflict's exposure to audiences following the show beyond television.

With information from UOL.
